name: Holt Lumber Company LLC
old_description: Holt Lumber Company LLC is a lumber and building materials supplier based in Clarksburg, West Virginia. They provide dimensional lumber, wood products, and building materials to contractors and homeowners in the region.
about:
Holt Lumber Company operates from Clarksburg, West Virginia, as a family-owned business serving the Appalachian region. The company supplies kiln-dried hardwoods and live-edge slabs to woodworkers, contractors, and homeowners across West Virginia, Pennsylvania, Virginia, Tennessee, Kentucky, and Ohio.

The company stocks a range of domestic hardwoods — including black walnut, cedar, white oak, and red oak — and offers custom woodworking, consulting, and delivery services. Its team mills and acclimates lumber on-site, providing dimensional lumber, building materials, and bespoke pieces built from customer-supplied photos or drawings.

Customers include professional woodworkers, residential builders, and DIY enthusiasts. Testimonials reference projects such as a walnut bar top, cedar and walnut lumber packages, and white-oak shelving with red-oak skirt boards, illustrating the mix of retail and custom work.

Holt Lumber emphasizes locally sourced Appalachian hardwoods from West Virginia mills, premium kiln-dried stock with moisture-content guidance, and a relationship-driven approach rooted in family ownership and hands-on expertise.
